title: Initial Inception
description: Originally founded as the 'Society for the Welfare of Special Persons' in Lahore by Mr. Mahmood Aslam to create meaningful community care for special individuals.

title: Birth of Roshni Association
description: Shahida Perveen (trained Waldorf educator) partnered with Mrs. Nasira Mahmood and Hellmut Hannesen (German Curative Education) to revive the mission, establishing Roshni Association.

title: First Day Care Center (Sep 3, 2001)
description: Following extensive preparatory work with curative teachers Lars Jamke and Graham Simpson, Roshni opened its first center in Lahore offering daily artistic and therapeutic care.

title: Move to Karbath, Bedian Road
description: Roshni acquired expansive land at Karbath Soling to establish 'Roshni Village'—a sustainable rural community where special friends and co-workers live and work together in harmony.

title: Green Earth Roshni School Founded
description: Inaugurated the Green Earth School, bringing Waldorf-inspired holistic education to underprivileged rural village children free of cost.

title: Organic Workshops & Bakery Expansion
description: Expanded vocational workshops into 5 daily units: traditional wood-fired organic bakery, textile weaving/embroidery, woodworking, art studio, and bio-dynamic organic farm.

title: Community Based Rehabilitation (CBR)
description: Initiated rural outreach program providing physical therapy, rehabilitation, and medical aid to disabled individuals across neighboring rural settlements.

title: Thriving Inclusive Community
description: A pioneering social community in Pakistan supporting resident special friends, educating hundreds of village children, and welcoming local and global volunteers.
